_comment: Combat chains per class (class name as in races_classes): opener -> steps (up to 4) -> finisher, by ability display name (class_abilities.display_name). Landing one ability opens a reaction window (window seconds, default 6) for the next; steps and the finisher can only be used through it. The chain abilities are added to the class's ability book. Placeholder chains: which abilities really chained, and their windows, were server data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md).
